placements.why: The expressions carry one thematic subject that future envelopes will keep feeding: a signed-release-manifest requirement that gates Meridian deploys to staging and production, its stated incident rationale (unsigned artifacts reaching staging), and its named owner. This is a standing control theme, not a fact or one-time event, so it is a leaf. No existing graph structure or strata was supplied, so nothing could be reused, and no existing node is an exact or close fit, so the leaf stands alone. The memo header (src-1, src-2) and the 'Key decisions:' heading (src-4) carry metadata or framing without thematic content of their own and are left unplaced.
placements.title: From trusting artifacts to verifying them before they ship
placements.frame: Where is an unsigned release artifact stopped before it reaches a deploy target, and who answers for that stop?
consulted: STRATA REFERENCE Process/ChangeManagement and Organization/QualityReviewGates considered as region context only; not attach targets
